_comment: DRAFT, not registered. For the official MCP registry (registry.modelcontextprotocol.io) after G2 (public repository) and T4 (the package on PyPI). The reverse-DNS name under ai.leadgreen needs domain verification at publish time (a DNS TXT record on leadgreen.ai or an HTTP challenge, per the registry's publishing guide); the exact schema URL and field names must be checked against the registry's current schema on the day, since the registry was in preview through 2025. Stdio only, per G8 as drafted: no hosted remote until CORS, HSTS and a rate limit are live.
name: ai.leadgreen/green-token-index
description: GPU energy per million output tokens by model, GPU and configuration, with grid carbon by country, from public measurements; every answer names its source and the GPU-only floor caveat.
_tools_for_listings: list_models: which models are on the index and on which GPUs
energy_per_million_tokens(model, gpu?, itl_deadline_ms?): the best row per GPU for a model

estimate(model, output_tokens, gpu?, country?, running_batch?, num_gpus?, itl_deadline_ms?, pue?, system_power_ratio?): GPU energy in Wh and kWh for a token count, kg CO2e for a grid, optionally energy at the meter
compare_gpus(model, itl_deadline_ms?): H100 against B200 for a model
concurrency_curve(model, gpu): energy per token at every measured running batch
grid_intensity(country): annual average gCO2e per kWh for a country or World
gpu_hardware(gpu?): max TDP, memory, MIG profiles and whole-system ceilings
sources: every source, version, retrieval date and licence

_listing_copy.one_line: Sourced GPU energy per million output tokens for 18 open-weight models on H100 and B200, with carbon by country.
_listing_copy.short: [G1 once approved.] Lead Green is a public index of the GPU energy it takes to serve a million output tokens (watt-hours per million output tokens), by model, GPU and configuration, with grid carbon intensity to price it anywhere, published as open data with a JSON API and an MCP server under CC BY 4.0. Every figure comes from a named public source with a retrieval date; it is a Katonic project, run and paid for by Katonic, and takes no money from hardware, cloud or model vendors.
_listing_copy.pulsemcp_and_smithery: Same description; category: data and analytics; licence Apache 2.0 (code), data CC BY 4.0; install: uvx leadgreen-mcp (once on PyPI).
